title: Following parade clarinets and the Wendell Phillips High School crowd
summary: He loved the clarinet, followed parade bands with Omer Simeon, and names famous alumni of Wendell Phillips High School.

bands.name: Eighth Illinois Infantry National Guard Band

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: The piano? I studied (unintelligible) chords on it, and I was taking some lessons, but I always liked the clarinet. I used to follow the band when we was at -- when -- they had the parade?
I'd be right by the clarinet section, me and Omer Simcon and friend of -- we came up together on the clarinet, and we was going to listen to the clarinet. We didn't care about the other --
When did Elmer Simcon come up from New Orleans?
Simcon came back there because him and his brother went to school there, and they came up -- must have been in the early years because this was around 1922 and '21. We were going to high school.
Oh, I see. Where? Wendell Phillips?
That's where I went to, Wendell
Well, I mean that was -- more people came out of that school than --
That's true. Milt Hinton (Unintelligible) and Hampton, bunch of them came out of that school.
And Nat Cole come out of there?
Yeah, because Nat, you know, when Hamp was going -- was there drumming, he went in -- I went into the National Guard band --
